basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Field Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Civil Engineering, IIT Guwahati, has one Field Engineer post in a project for the appointment of a Third-Party Quality Assurance (TPQA) agency for the Development of New Civil Enclave at Bagdogra Airport. The pay is Rs.55,000 plus HRA at 10% of Basic, for 4 months. A degree in Civil Engineering and a minimum of 5 years' experience are required. Apply online on the Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell by 19 November 2026; the online interview is on 20 November 2026 at 12:00 Noon.

how_to_apply: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati, at https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/.
Find the Field Engineer position by searching for the project title exactly as it appears in this advertisement.
Follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.
Check the application status on the application portal.

For technical help with the online application, the notice gives the email [email protected]. For any clarification, contact Principal Investigator Dr. Sparsh Johari at [email protected] or +91-361-258 3226.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the test or interview. Candidates must follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Field Engineer at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, Research and Development Section

Appointment of Third-Party Quality Assurance (TPQA) agency for the project work, Development of New Civil Enclave at Bagdogra Airport. SH: Construction of Apron, Link Taxiways and Airside infrastructure (Phase-1); Project No: 2627C-0418-CIEN1331SPAR
Rs.55,000; HRA 10% of Basic; medical facility: Yes
Department of Civil Engineering, IIT Guwahati

content_sections.heading: About IIT Guwahati
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located at Guwahati-781039, Assam. This notice is issued by its Research and Development Section for a project run in the Department of Civil Engineering. The project concerns the Development of New Civil Enclave at Bagdogra Airport (Construction of Apron, Link Taxiways and Airside infrastructure, Phase-1).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice says 7 or more years of experience is preferred. The notice prints no other desirable qualification. For discipline-specific eligibility, check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Geotechnical cum Health & Safety Engineer: Degree in Civil Engineering; minimum of 5 years' experience; experience in civil works, including pavement works; Environmental, Health, and Safety works.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Field Engineer
content_sections.text: For technical help with the online application, the notice gives the email [email protected] . For any clarification, contact Principal Investigator Dr. Sparsh Johari at [email protected] or +91-361-258 3226.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the interview. The interview is online and is held on 20 November 2026 (Friday) at 12:00 Noon; the notice lists the venue as the Department of Civil Engineering, IIT Guwahati. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail about the online link of the interview on 20 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the test or interview. Candidates must follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.

faq.question: Q1. How many Field Engineer posts are vacant at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Field Engineer in the Department of Civil Engineering project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Guwahati Field Engineer?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Field Engineer post?
faq.answer: A degree in Civil Engineering and a minimum of 5 years' experience are required, including experience in civil works (including pavement works) and Environmental, Health, and Safety works. 7 or more years of experience is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Guwahati Field Engineer?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.55,000, with HRA at 10% of Basic and medical facility.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The duration of appointment is 4 months.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online on the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati (https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/) by searching for the project title given in the advertisement.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on the candidate's performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. When and how is the interview held?
faq.answer: The interview is online on 20 November 2026 at 12:00 Noon. Shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail about the interview link on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the test or interview.
